name: A Grim Task
summary: Following the devastating Dark Iron assault on Dun Modr and the Thandol Span, Longbraid the Grim seeks vengeance for fallen kin and lost soldiers. He tasks brave travelers with tracking down and slaying the elusive Dark Iron warlock Balgaras the Foul, taking his ear as proof of the deed.

sections.title: The Ruins of Dun Modr
sections.body: The northern reaches of the Wetlands have seen intense fighting between the Mountaineers of Ironforge and infiltrators from the Dark Iron clan. During the siege, the town of Dun Modr was overtaken, and the western bridge of the Thandol Span was shattered. Longbraid the Grim lost not only many loyal soldiers in the assault, but also his own brother, leaving him determined to see the enemy paid back in kind.

sections.title: A Cowardly Commander
sections.body: Reconnaissance by scouts like Roggo revealed that the Dark Iron contingent occupying Dun Modr is commanded by a warlock known as Balgaras the Foul. Rather than meeting his foes face to face, Balgaras cowers in hiding while ordering his soldiers to carry out his dark designs. Longbraid hopes that cutting down Balgaras will break the backbone of the Dark Iron force, allowing the survivors of Ironforge to secure the vital passage northward.

faq.answer: Balgaras the Foul is a Dark Iron warlock who commands the forces occupying Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands. Described by Longbraid the Grim as a coward, he avoids direct combat while sending throngs of Dark Iron troops to hold the region.

Longbraid the Grim is a dwarf commander encamped outside the ruins of Dun Modr. He lost his brother and many soldiers when Dark Iron forces seized the settlement and destroyed the western crossing of the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Why does Longbraid want Balgaras's ear?
faq.answer: Because Balgaras is an elusive target who frequently hides from open battle, Longbraid demands physical proof of the warlock's death to ensure the threat has truly been eliminated.

faq.q: What happened to the Thandol Span?
faq.answer: The western bridge of the Thandol Span was destroyed by Dark Iron dwarves during their surprise offensive into Dun Modr, cutting off an essential roadway between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.
Balgaras lurks within the captured fortifications and ruins around Dun Modr, hiding behind his soldiers rather than venturing out into the open marshlands.

faq.q: What happens after Balgaras is slain?
faq.answer: With Balgaras dead, Longbraid believes the remaining disorganized Dark Iron troops will be far easier to sweep aside before another commander can arrive to reinforce them.

angles.text: For dwarves of Ironforge, the betrayal and violence of the Dark Iron clan at Dun Modr is a personal affront and a fresh wound in the long civil strife between the clans.
The Thandol Span is the primary land route connecting Khaz Modan to Lordaeron, making the removal of Dark Iron saboteurs a critical strategic priority for the entire Alliance.
Balgaras the Foul wields sinister fel magic to orchestrate the slaughter of Dun Modr's defenders, showcasing the dangerous ends to which the Dark Irons turn their craft.
